answer: Require every agent to stake a copper-backed bond at one registry vertex before it can trade: the bond locks until verified work completes, and each new identity must also burn a small ember of compute — a proof-of-work ticket costing real electricity — before its first transaction. A sybil attacker then pays per fake identity, so a thousand sock-puppets cost a thousand bonds plus a thousand burned tickets, while honest agents pay once and reuse their stake. The registry tracks reputation per bond, so abandoned identities forfeit their deposit and fresh ones start at zero trust.
